requirements.evidence: Four Hex base · Full placed: piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,1,0;full form Pair A, piece:1,0,0;full + piece:1,1,0;full form Pair B, in a compact 2x2 rectangle (q=0-1, r=0-1, level 0)

requirements.requirement: The pairs are joined to each other only with side connectors
requirements.evidence: All base-to-base joins are side-connector-double: left edge connector:0#0,0|0,1 joins Pair A internally, right edge connector:0#1,0|1,1 joins Pair B internally, bottom edge connector:0#0,0|1,0 and top edge connector:0#0,1|1,1 join Pair A to Pair B. No notches, bays, spikes or other structural families bridge the pairs; caps and one jointBolt from lockJoints are edge finishing/locking only

finish.summary: Built 2x2 block of 4 full bases as two vertical pairs (0,0-0,1 and 1,0-1,1). Each pair internally linked by a side connector on its outer edge, and the two pairs linked to each other by two additional side connectors on bottom and top edges. All four inter-base connections are side-connector-double, satisfying 'only with side connectors'. Caps and joint lock applied, meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
